source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API
notes: Jobs ending in 4 (114/124/134) are the 6th-job (HEXA) skillbooks, not Hyper books: job 134 holds Dark Knight's HEXA skills (HEXA Gungnir's Descent, HEXA Dark Impale, Dark Bident, HEXA Nightshade Explosion, HEXA Revenge of the Evil Eye, Evil Eye's Punishment, HEXA Final Attack, HEXA Evil Eye Shock) plus the Origin skills Dead Space and Dark Halidom, each with its own effect/hit frames in GMS 270.
Unlike Hero (whose HEXA Raging Blow shares Raging Blow 1121008's frames), Dark Knight's HEXA skills have distinct effect/hit nodes in Skill/134.img — no shared-frame entries are used.

Calamitous Cyclone 400011068 is hit-only (6 frames); the full cast is the sibling entry 400011069 (19 effect + 6 hit). Darkness Aura likewise has two entries (400011047 and 400011085) with distinct frames.

HEXA boost cores for the class's 1st–4th-job skills are recorded as passive entries (400004022 Final Attack, 400004023 Spear Sweep, 400004024 La Mancha Spear, 400004027 Evil Eye, 400004032 Dark Impale, 400004033 Gungnir's Descent, 400004034 Nightshade Explosion).

skills.name: Iron Body
skills.description: Boosts DEF and Max HP by a set percentage, and decreases damage taken when hit by enemies.

skills.name: Guardian Armor
skills.description: Increase Battle Mode ATT based on DEF.

skills.name: Warrior Mastery
skills.description: Trains up your warrior basics to increase Movement Speed, Jump, Max HP, and Max Movement Speed. Also grants a chance to resist knockback.

skills.name: Slash Blast
skills.description: Consumes MP to attack nearby enemies all at once.

skills.name: War Leap
skills.description: Leap once more while already in the air. Press the up key at the same time to move upward.

skills.name: Leap Attack
skills.description: Ambush the enemy by rapidly dropping to ground from mid-air.\nCan only be used if there's a platform within range below you. Use along with a left or right arrow keys to drop yourself diagonally.\nCan also be used by pressing the downward, left, or right arrow keys plus the attack key, instead of manually activating the skill.

skills.name: War Leap
skills.description: Charge through the air to attack the enemy. Can also be used by pressing the upward arrow key plus the attack key.\nRight-click to lock command.

skills.name: Weapon Mastery
skills.description: Increases Spear and Polearm Mastery.

skills.name: Final Attack
skills.description: Grants a chance to deliver an additional hit after a direct skill attack. Must have a spear or a polearm equipped.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Agile Arms
skills.description: Increases weapon Attack Speed and Strength.

skills.name: Iron Wall
skills.description: Steel your resolve to bolster your defenses.

skills.name: Hyper Body
skills.description: Increases your Max HP and Max MP for a set amount of time.

skills.name: Spear Sweep
skills.description: Swings your spear to pull in enemies and stun them.

skills.name: Evil Eye
skills.description: Summons an Evil Eye, which heals you regularly when it is near. Can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Evil Eye Shock
skills.description: Your Evil Eye shouts, stunning and damaging nearby enemies.\nUnaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Lord of Darkness
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage, and grants a chance to recover HP during the attack.

skills.name: Endure
skills.description: Enhances your Abnormal Status Resistance and Elemental Resistance.

skills.name: Evil Eye of Domination
skills.description: Summons an Evil Eye to freely attack nearby enemies.\nYour Evil Eye's attacks will not cause you to take damage from attack reflection.

skills.name: Hex of the Evil Eye
skills.description: Your Evil Eye periodically buffs you and your party members.

skills.name: Evil Eye Shock II
skills.description: Empowers Evil Eye Shock, increasing its damage.

skills.name: La Mancha Spear
skills.description: Spin your spear to attack enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Rush
skills.description: Dashes forward and pushes back multiple monsters. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Cross Surge
skills.description: Increases final damage for a short time. Also reduces damage taken proportional to reduced HP.

skills.name: Evil Eye Shock II
skills.description: Your Evil Eye shouts, stunning and damaging nearby enemies.\nUnaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Revenge of the Evil Eye
skills.description: An Evil Eye counterattacks the enemy. The Evil Eye periodically marks enemies struck by the Dark Knight with a vengeful brand which deals damage.\nAdditionally, your deepened connection with the Evil Eye enhances Evil Eye Shock.\nYour Evil Eye's attacks are not affected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Final Pact
skills.description: When your HP reaches 0, your dark contract keeps you alive, granting invincibility based on the type selected in Accept Final Pact. Additionally, if you eliminate and successfully attack the required number of monsters for a set period of time after invincibility ends, cooldown will be reduced until the next contract.\nNot affected by cooldown reset. Permanently increases Final Damage, Speed, Critical Rate, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Power Stance
skills.description: Concentrates to hold your ground when struck, resisting knock-back effects.

skills.name: Barricade Mastery
skills.description: Improves Spear and Polearm Mastery to their human limits. Increases Critical Damage and Attack Power.

skills.name: Lesser Pact
skills.description: When your HP reaches 0, your dark contract keeps you alive, granting invincibility. Additionally, if you eliminate and successfully attack the required number of monsters for a set period of time after invincibility ends, cooldown will be reduced until the next contract.\nUnaffected by cooldown reset.

skills.name: Moderate Pact
skills.description: When your HP reaches 0, your dark contract keeps you alive, granting invincibility. Additionally, if you eliminate and successfully attack the required number of monsters for a set period of time after invincibility ends, cooldown will be reduced until the next contract.\nUnaffected by cooldown reset.

skills.name: Greater Pact
skills.description: When your HP reaches 0, your dark contract keeps you alive, granting invincibility. Additionally, if you eliminate and successfully attack the required number of monsters for a set period of time after invincibility ends, cooldown will be reduced until the next contract.\nUnaffected by cooldown reset.

skills.name: Evil Eye - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases damage for Evil Eye Domination, Evil Eye Shock, Revenge of the Eye, and Radiant Evil.

skills.name: Evil Eye - Hex Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Hex of the Evil Eye's Attack Power and Magic ATT boost.

skills.name: Evil Eye - Aura Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the amount healed by Aura of the Evil Eye

skills.name: Final Pact - Damage
skills.description: Increases passive final damage of Final Pact. Stacks with existing final damage bonuses.

skills.name: Final Pact - Reduce Target
skills.description: Reduces the number of enemies that must be defeated to reduce the cooldown for reusing all versions of Final Pact.

skills.name: Final Pact - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate bonus from Final Pact's passive effect.

skills.name: Gungnir's Descent - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Gungnir's Descent's damage.

skills.name: Gungnir's Descent - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Ignore Defense for Gungnir's Descent.

skills.name: Gungnir's Descent - Boss Rush
skills.description: Damage increases when attacking Boss Monsters with Gungnir's Descent.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Final Pact Alter
skills.description: The Contract of Darkness nullifies all attacks.\nCan only be used while Final Pact Alter mode is active.\nUnaffected by cooldown resets.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Dark Impale
skills.description: Launch rapid spear thrusts on multiple enemies.

skills.name: Gungnir's Descent
skills.description: Throws a mythical spear to deal fatal damage. You can deal higher damage with greater Max HP.

skills.name: Magic Crash
skills.description: Chance to remove certain buffs from affected enemies and prevent them regaining those buffs.\nEnemies hit will resist Magic Crash for 90 seconds. Buffs Removed: Attack Power & Magic ATT Bonuses, DEF Bonuses, and Obsidian Skin.

skills.name: Dark Resonance
skills.description: Resonates with your Evil Eye to unlock the power of pure darkness. Fully restores your HP and temporarily increases Final Damage, Ignore Defense, and Boss Damage upon using the skill. Additionally, increases Ignore Defense effect permanently.

skills.name: Accept Final Pact
skills.description: Forges a contract with the darkness. If HP falls to 0 while a selected pact is in effect, Final Pact will activate. Cannot trigger while Final Pact is on cooldown.\nCan be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Evil Eye Shock III
skills.description: The Evil Eye lets out a scream that stuns and damages nearby enemies, then releases spectral shadows which deal additional damage.\nUnaffected by attack reflection.\nRequired Skill: Evil Eye Shock II Lv. 20

skills.name: Nightshade Explosion
skills.description: Release your inner power to lay waste to nearby enemies. Can be used without casting motion while using Spear of Darkness.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Dark Thirst
skills.description: Channels your inner vampire to increase Attack Power and sap life from enemies for a short time.

skills.name: Spear of Darkness
skills.description: Hurls a spear of utter darkness at the enemy. Direct the spear with the up and down arrow keys. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Darkness Aura
skills.description: By the power of the enhanced contract with darkness, unleash a dark aura to both siphon enemies' life force and add a special ability.\nDarkness Aura is unaffected by Attack Reflection. Reusing this skill will unleash a deadly attack. During the final attack of Gungnir's Descent, Nightshade Explosion, and Calamitous Cyclone, it is possible to cancel the final detonation.

skills.name: Radiant Evil
skills.description: The Evil Eye reveals itself and blasts nearby enemies. Only usable while Evil Eye of Domination is active. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Calamitous Cyclone
skills.description: Swings a spear so fast it creates a dark storm and devastates the area in front of you. The final attack is unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.

skills.name: HEXA Revenge of the Evil Eye
skills.description: An Evil Eye counterattacks the enemy, dealing damage to enemies struck by your attacks.\nThe Evil Eye marks enemies with a vengeful brand for a set number of attacks. When the vengeful brands are completely full, Enhanced Revenge of the Evil Eye activates.\nYour Evil Eye's attacks are not affected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Final Attack
skills.description: Grants a chance to deliver an additional hit after a direct skill attack. Must have a spear or a polearm equipped.

skills.name: HEXA Gungnir's Descent
skills.description: Throws a mythical spear to deal fatal damage. You can deal higher damage with greater Max HP.

skills.name: HEXA Dark Impale
skills.description: Launches rapid spear thrusts at multiple enemies, harnessing the power of darkness in the spear at set intervals to unleash Dark Bident, sweeping through enemies with great force.

skills.name: Dark Bident
skills.description: Envelops the spear in the power of darkness and swings it with great force.

skills.name: HEXA Nightshade Explosion
skills.description: Releases your inner power to lay waste to nearby enemies. Can be used without casting motion while using Spear of Darkness. Additionally, permanently enhances HEXA Gungnir's Descent.

skills.name: HEXA Revenge of the Evil Eye
HEXA Evil Eye Shock
skills.description: The Evil Eye lets out a scream that stuns and damages nearby enemies, then releases spectral shadows which deal additional damage.\nUnaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Dead Space
skills.description:
Throws a spear charged with dark energy to steal the life of all in its way.

Lv. 10: Ignore Defense +20%
Lv. 20: Boss Damage +20%
Lv. 30: Ignore Defense +30% and Boss Damage +30%

skills.name: Dark Halidom
skills.description:
Launches a spear imbued with the power of your dark contract, bringing utter destruction to your enemies.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%

skills.note: All 669 IDs in the Skill/40000.img 400004xxx block were scanned by name (4000040xx block plus 400004100-400004885); every entry is a 1st-4th-job Boost core and none is a V-skill Boost. The 400001xxx block holds common skills (Rope Lift, Decent skills, Blitz Shield) and 400007xxx holds HEXA stat cores, so no "<V skill> Boost" entry exists in Skill/40000.img in GMS 270.
